Dunford, along with USO entertainers, will visit service members who are deployed from home during the holidays at various locations across the globe. Scarlett Johansson at the premiere of a Girl With a Pearl Earring, Toronto Film Festival 2003. Managed to get this one later the same night. This goes to show you, lighting is important. Little did I know at the time, this movie would vault her to fame, so I have her autograph basically on a napkin.

Wiki folks like this pic so much, it's on her page. <a href="http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scarlett_Johansson" rel="nofollow">en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Scarlett_Johansson</a>
